q: Kituufu nti George Whitefield yatandika ng'akolera mu nnyumba y'abagenyi?
a: Yee. Yazaalibwa mu December 1714 mu Bell Inn ku Southgate Street, Gloucester, nnyina gye yali akuuma ennyumba y'abagenyi, era ng'akyali mulenzi yayambala apuloni eya bbululu n'akwata ebisalira by'ettabaaza, n'ayoza emimoppu, n'ayonja ebisenge, era n'afuuka omuweereza w'omwenge ow'awamu okumala kumpi omwaka gumu n'ekitundu. Ne mu kiseera ekyo yawandiikanga okubuulira mu kasirise mu ssaawa ez'enjawulo. Teyerabira nti yatandikira wansi nnyo, era obulamu bwe bwonna yanywereza nti Katonda yamusanga eyo n'amuyimusa.

q: Omulenzi eyali aweereza mu nnyumba y'omwenge yatuuka atya mu Oxford?
a: Mu November 1732 yayingira Pembroke College, Oxford, nga servitor — ekifo ekya wansi ennyo mu bayizi ab'ediguli esooka, omuyizi eyeesasuliranga okusoma kwe ng'aweereza abayizi abagagga. Eyo yeegatta ku kabinja akatono akaasekererwanga akaali kamanyiddwa nga Holy Club, era ng'ayita mu Charles Wesley n'asoma ekitabo kya Henry Scougal The Life of God in the Soul of Man, ekyamukakasa nti eddiini ey'amazima si kukola wabula Kristo okubumbibwa munda. Yeetuuyaza nnyo n'okusiiba n'okwefiiriza, ng'agezaako okwefunira ekyo ekyandisobodde okuweebwa obuweebwa, n'okutuusa obulamu bwe lwe bwamugwako — era olwo lwokka obukakafu bw'okwagala kwa Katonda okusonyiwa ne bumenya ne buyingira mu ye.

q: Lwaki Whitefield yatandika okubuulira mu nnimiro enjereere mu kifo ky'amakkanisa?
a: Ettutumu lye bwe lyabuna, amakkanisa mangi ne gamwesibira enzigi olw'okunywerera kwe ku kuzaalibwa okuggya. Mu February ow'obunnyogovu ogwa 1739, ng'agaanyiddwa emimbari era nga tayagala kusirika, yeebagala embalaasi n'agenda eri abasima amanda ab'e Kingswood okumpi ne Bristol, n'abuulira mu bbanga eddungi eri abasima amanda nga ebikumi bibiri. "Katonda atenderezebwe kubanga kaakano mmenye omuzira!" bwe yawandiika — era mu wiiki ntono ebibinja byali bifuuse enkumi.

q: Eddoboozi lye ddala lyali lya maanyi nga engero bwe zigamba?
a: Lyali lya kitalo. Mu Philadelphia, Benjamin Franklin eyali abuusabuusa, ng'awuliriza ng'ali mu kibiina era ng'atambula ng'addayo emabega okupima eddoboozi we lyatuukanga, yabalirira nti Whitefield yasobolanga okuwulirwa abantu abali okumpi n'obukumi busatu omulundi gumu. Franklin teyagabana naye kukkiriza kwe, naye yafuuka mukwano gwe ow'amazima, n'akuba ebitabo bye eby'entambula, era n'asiima omusajja oyo okutuusa ku nkomerero.

q: Whitefield yakola ki ddala mu Amerika ey'omu biseera by'amatwale?
a: Yasomoka ennyanja Atlantic okukyalira Amerika emirundi musanvu, entambula z'ennyanja kkumi na ssatu byonna awamu, mu kiseera buli kusomoka we kwategeezanga emyezi n'emyezi mu meeri ya mbaawo. Mu 1739 ne 1740 yatambula okuva Georgia okutuuka New England n'okudda, ng'abuulira buli lunaku, era obuzuukuka obutonotono obw'eddiini obwali busaasaanidde ne bwegatta emabega we ne bufuuka ekyo kye tuyita kaakano Great Awakening. Mu butuufu, yafuuka omuntu asooka okumanyibwa buli muntu ku lubalama lw'ennyanja lwonna olw'Amerika, era yamanyibwa olw'obubaka bumu: kikugwanidde okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri.

q: Ekisulo ky'abaana bamulekwa ekya Bethesda kyali ki, era kituufu nti yalina abantu abaafuulibwa abaddu?
a: Bethesda, eyatandikibwa okumpi ne Savannah nga 25 March 1740, ye yali omugugu omunene ogw'obulamu bwe; okumala emyaka amakumi asatu yagisabiranga era n'agikuŋŋaanyiza ssente, n'agifukamu ssente ze ye yennyini, era okukebera kw'ensimbi okwakolebwa n'ekirayiro kwakakasa nti teyatwala wadde ssente emu ku lulwe. Naye obwesimbu bwetaagisa akatundu akasinga obuzibu. Ng'akakasa nti ennyumba eyo teyandisobodde kuwangaala ng'esinziira ku mulimu ogutasasulwa, yakozesa ssente ze yaweebwa e Charleston okugula ennimiro n'abantu abaafuulibwa abaddu okugirimira olw'okuwanirira ekisulo, era yeegayirira Abakuumi ba Georgia okuggyawo ekiragiro ky'essaza ekyagaana obuddu, ekyaggwaawo mu 1751. Yalina abasajja n'abakazi abaafuulibwa abaddu okutuusa lwe yafa, era okwagala kwonna okw'amazima eri ye kuteekwa okukwata ekintu kino nga tekikendeezeddwa maanyi.

q: Yabuulira abantu abaafuulibwa abaddu, era ekyo tukigatta tutya n'obuddu?
a: Yabuulira ddala abaddu era n'anywereza nti baalina emmeeme ezisaanidde okulokolebwa, era edda yali anenyezza abalimi ab'omu bukiikaddyo mu bitabo ebyafulumizibwa olw'obukambwe bwabwe eri abo be baali bakutte. Naye omusajja oyo yennyini yawandiika nti obusuubuzi bw'abaddu bwali "busuubuzi obutasaana kukkirizibwa," n'abuyita nsobi, ate n'azimba omulimu gwe ogw'ekisa ku bwo wadde bwe kityo. Enjiri gye yabuulira olunaku olumu yandiwadde eby'okulwanyisa abo abaamalawo obuddu; teyatuuka ku bitabo bye ebyo eby'ensimbi, era okwekontana okwo kukwe, so si kintu ekyayiiyizibwa oluvannyuma.

q: Whitefield ne John Wesley baali mikwano oba bavuganya?
a: Baali byombi. Bombi baali baaganda mu Holy Club, era Whitefield ye yakwasa Wesley ennimiro enjereere e Kingswood, naye baayawukana mu lwatu mu 1740 Whitefield, Omukalvini eyali akakasizza, bwe yaddamu okubuulira kwa Wesley Free Grace okwawakanya okulondebwa okw'edda. Whitefield yajja okwejjusa nnyo oluyoogaano lw'oluyombo olwo era n'agaana okululeka okufuuka obulabe; baaddamu okubuulira buli omu mu mimbari gya munne era baayagalana okutuusa ku nkomerero. Bwe yabuuzibwa ani yandibuulidde ku kuziika kwe, Whitefield yagamba ku Wesley nti, "Ye musajja waakyo" — era amawulire bwe gaatuuka, Wesley n'abuulira.

Okubuulira kwe kukyaliwo mu bibuulwa ebyakubibwa nga The Method of Grace, The Lord Our Righteousness, Marks of a True Conversion, ne Walking with God, byonna nga byetooloola omulamwa gumu ogw'okuzaalibwa okuggya n'obutuukirivu obufunibwa so si obukolerwa. Obunene bw'omulimu gwe buzibu okukkiriza: mukwano gwe Henry Venn yajulira nti okumala emyaka mingi Whitefield yabuuliranga essaawa amakumi ana okutuuka ku nkaaga buli wiiki.

Ng'akooye nnyo era ng'alwadde obulwadde bw'okuzibikirwa omukka ng'aweza emyaka amakumi ataano mu etaano, yagamba nti yandisinze okuggwaawo ng'akola okusinga okuliibwa obutalagala. Nga 29 September 1770 yabuulira essaawa bbiri mu nnimiro okumpi ne Exeter ng'amaze okusaba nti, "Mukama Yesu, nkooye mu mulimu gwo, naye omulimu gwo tegunkooya," oluvannyuma n'atambula okutuuka e Newburyport, Massachusetts, era n'afa ku makya ennyo ag'enkeera, nga 30 September 1770, mu nnyumba y'omusumba eya Old South Presbyterian Church. Nga bwe yali yeeyagalidde, yaziikibwa mu ntaana eri wansi w'omumbari eyo — ekintu ekituukiridde ddala, wansi w'ekifo eky'okubuulirirako.
